title: Psalms 64
paragraphs: ¹ Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint; protect my life from the threat of the enemy. ² Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the scheming of wrongdoers, ³ who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim bitter words like arrows, ⁴ shooting from ambush at the blameless — suddenly, without fear. ⁵ They encourage one another in evil plans; they talk about hiding their snares and say, "Who will see them?"

⁶ They plot injustice and say, "We have perfected a shrewd scheme." The human heart and mind are deep. ⁷ But God will shoot them with his arrow; suddenly they will be wounded. ⁸ He will turn their own tongues against them, and all who see them will shake their heads. ⁹ All people will fear and proclaim what God has done, pondering what he has carried out. ¹⁰ The righteous will rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in him; all the upright in heart will glory.
